name: nexus-bridge
description: Connects Legacy to the OneMind OS NATS nervous system

tools.name: nexus_dispatch
tools.description: Dispatch a task or command to an Agno agent or OM1 robot via NATS

agent.description: Target Agno agent ID (researcher, coder, analyst, web_automator, db_manager, assistant)

robot_id.description: Target robot ID (e.g. om1-home-01) — use instead of agent for physical tasks

task.description: The task description or command to send

command.description: Robot command (navigate, capture, patrol, etc.) — only for robot_id targets

wait_for_result.description: Wait for agent to return a result (max 60s). Default false for async dispatch.

tools.name: nexus_query
tools.description: Query the OneMind OS system state via NATS — health checks, status, metrics

subject.description: NATS subject to query (e.g. nexus.system.health, physical.robot.om1-home-01.status)

tools.name: nexus_publish
tools.description: Publish a raw event to any NATS subject
